module_summary: 16-bit carry-lookahead adder: four 4-bit CLA blocks produce sums and group P/G, a second-level lookahead computes inter-block carries c4/c8/c12 and group px/gx.

anchors.name: A
anchors.why: 16-bit operand A, sliced into four nibbles for the 4-bit adders.

anchors.name: B
anchors.why: 16-bit operand B, sliced into four nibbles for the 4-bit adders.

anchors.name: S
anchors.why: 16-bit sum assembled from the four adder_4 F outputs.

anchors.name: c0
anchors.why: Carry-in feeding adder1 and all lookahead carry equations.

anchors.name: c4
anchors.why: Representative lookahead carry into the next 4-bit block (c8, c12 alike).

anchors.name: px
anchors.why: 16-bit group propagate output for a higher-level lookahead unit.

anchors.name: gx
anchors.why: 16-bit group generate output for a higher-level lookahead unit.

anchors.name: Pm1
anchors.why: Representative 4-bit block group propagate feeding carry lookahead.

anchors.name: Gm1
anchors.why: Representative 4-bit block group generate feeding carry lookahead.

groups.name: 4-bit CLA adder blocks
groups.description: Four adder_4 slices computing nibble sums and group P/G.

groups.name: Second-level carry lookahead
groups.description: Computes block carries c4/c8/c12 and 16-bit px/gx from Pm/Gm.
